root_causes.cause: Image entrypoint /opt/nvidia/deepstream/deepstream/entrypoint.sh runs as PID 1 in bash without exec, so SIGTERM was ignored and docker stop always waited its 10 s grace before SIGKILL.
root_causes.measurement: docker stop of a sleeping container: 10.49 s without --init, 0.45 s with --init. Real extractor mid-run under --init: stopped in 0.66 s at ~375/710 frames, last JSONL line valid, no run-summary (process killed).

root_causes.cause: The backend stdout reader stopped reading when stop_event was set. wsl.exe, still relaying container stdout, blocked on the full unread Windows pipe and could not exit, so process.wait(5) timed out and the wrapper was killed.
root_causes.measurement: Instrumented backend stop with --init only: docker stop 0.8 s, then process.wait(5) timeout -> kill (total 5.83 s). After fix: 0.72 s and 0.78 s total, wrapper exit rc=143 (SIGTERM), no kill.
root_causes.fix: backend/app/perception/service_maker.py: reader keeps draining (discarding) stdout after stop until EOF; regression test fails on the old logic and passes on the new one.

root_causes.cause: docker stop subprocess timeout (10 s) equalled docker's default grace (10 s), so the call could time out before docker's own SIGKILL escalation.
root_causes.fix: docker stop --time 5 with subprocess timeout 15 s; non-zero exit is logged.

related_defect_found_during_validation.defect: analytics_fps = 1/(delta time.monotonic()) per frame was None whenever consecutive frames shared a ~15.6 ms Windows clock tick; the first new validation run failed first_pre_eos_fresh_metrics_present because every pre-EOS sample had analytics_fps=null (the original PASS showed 62.5 = 1/16 ms, a tick artifact).
related_defect_found_during_validation.fix: ArrivalRate: frames over a 2 s perf_counter window, reported only once arrivals span >= 0.5 s.
related_defect_found_during_validation.measurement: Full real run: 710 frames arrive steadily (78-96 per 250 ms) over ~1.95 s, mean 365 frames/s; reported analytics_fps 361-391. The file pipeline runs unpaced (sync=False), roughly 12x the 29.97 fps source rate. Bursts after consumer delays can legitimately report higher momentary rates (1032 observed once).

end_to_end_validation_runs.result: PASS 28/28, but analytics_fps 6704 judged a burst artifact; superseded

scope: Single camera, single clip, laptop. Stop latency is an observed timing, not a guaranteed bound or a multi-camera result.
scripts: Measurement scripts copied into this directory for reproducibility.
